item.title: Kuot Kiir once walked hours to school. Now he is building one.
item.description: Shaped by the educational barriers he faced growing up, Kuot Kiir ’27 founded the Akeer Foundation to build a school in his South Sudanese village. What began as an informal effort among friends has since grown into a university-backed initiative at Stanford. The post Kuot Kiir once walked hours to school. Now he is building one. appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Former Stanford professor Nathan Wolfe ’92 planned sexual behavior research, described interns with Epstein
item.description: The Daily investigated correspondence between virologist Nathan Wolfe ’92 and Epstein in which the two men discussed interns’ attractiveness, “female viagra” and sexual research projects. The post Former Stanford professor Nathan Wolfe ’92 planned sexual behavior research, described interns with Epstein appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.description: Stanford’s General Counsel Debra Zumwalt is retiring this August. Her colleagues credit her for drastically expanding the scope and abilities of her office. The post General Counsel Zumwalt to retire after 26 years appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
